title: Megurine Luka — Brand New School〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
This is a good performance...
Their feelings really shine through in the sound.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Actually, I feel like their sound has kinda changed since they became second-years!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I can't let myself get left behind!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This sound...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: As I thought, it was yours, Rin.
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, Luka!
Where are Ichi and the others?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They finalized their practice schedule moving forward and went back home just now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They all told me to say hi to you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Gotcha! Hehehe, I'm looking forward to their next practice♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Still, it's not often you start practicing on your own while the girls are still here, even if they are done practicing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Well, y'know!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Lately, when I listen to them perform, this feeling that I've just gotta practice builds up inside♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: True, that last one was the kind of intense performance that makes you want to play yourself.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! But the way I play now, I feel like there's something missing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I wonder if the feeling I'd get from starting something new would change my sound, just like it did for Ichi and the others when they became second-years.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Starting something new...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (It's true that changes in your mindset come out directly in your sound, so something like that could be good for us as well.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hey, Rin. If you want to experience something new, how about we have an opening ceremony amongst ourselves?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
An opening ceremony?
That's the thing Ichi and the others had when they became second-years, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. It'll put you in a new frame of mind, and that may cause a change in the way you sound.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Nice! That sounds fun!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, but I don't think I really know what happens at an opening ceremony...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Uhh... You listen to the principal talk for a suuuper long time, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Whether or not it feels long probably depends on the person... But it does seem like the principal gives a talk at all schools.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh... By the way, what kind of talk?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Well, according to Honami and the others...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Things like asking if the students spent their time off in a constructive way, or prompting them to put their utmost into their studies during the upcoming school year.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hmmm...
That doesn't sound very interesting.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ooh! Can it be the kind of talk Sakki gives, like about a TV episode from yesterday or the music we've been listening to lately?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Well... I do feel like it'd be nice for the principal to talk about those kinds of fun topics...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: However, the opening ceremony isn't about having a pleasant chat, but rather about preparing yourself to put your best foot forward in the next stage of your life.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's actually meaningful because it's taken so seriously.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. You seem perplexed, but that's how it is.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, I'd like to give this a try with everyone. Will you help me?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'll do it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I wanna really collect all my thoughts and feelings so I can improve my sound like Ichi and the others!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's settled, then.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Let's put on an opening ceremony here in SEKAI together.
